title: Weak convergence of the tangential derivatives of the smoothed functions on a rectifiable set (Simon's (1) in the proof of 4.5(2); supplied step 4)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, N := n + 1, H^N := μHE[N] and K ≥ 0. Let M ⊆ ℝ^P be Borel with H^N(M ∩ C) < ∞ for every compact C. Let h : ℝ^P → ℝ be K-Lipschitz. Let H : ℝ^P → ℝ^P be Borel with |H| ≤ K such that, for H^N-a.e. x ∈ M: M has approximate tangent space T_xM := approxTangentPlane N M x at x, H(x) ∈ T_xM, and for every ε > 0, r^{−N}·H^N(M ∩ B_r(x) ∩ {y : ε|y − x| < |h(y) − h(x) − ⟨H(x), y − x⟩|}) → 0 as r ↓ 0. Let (ψ_j, V_j, Y_j, F_j)_{j∈ℕ} be C¹ chart pieces of M adapted to h; this is exactly the conclusion of dtc_bc_lc_sl_chart_pieces for (M, h). That is, for every j: V_j is open; ψ_j is C¹, injective on V_j, with Dψ_j(y) injective for y ∈ V_j; F_j is C¹; Y_j is Borel with closure(Y_j) compact and contained in V_j; ψ_j(Y_j) ⊆ M; h∘ψ_j = F_j on Y_j; and M has approximate tangent space Dψ_j(y)(ℝ^N) at ψ_j(y) for y ∈ Y_j. Moreover the sets ψ_j(Y_j) are pairwise disjoint and H^N(M ∖ ∪_j ψ_j(Y_j)) = 0. Let h_k (k ∈ ℕ) be C¹ with ‖Dh_k‖ ≤ K and h_k → h uniformly. Let w : ℝ^P → ℝ^P be H^N-integrable on M with w(x) ∈ T_xM for H^N-a.e. x ∈ M. Then ∫_M Dh_k(x)(w(x)) dH^N → ∫_M ⟨H(x), w(x)⟩ dH^N as k → ∞.
